name: Courtside Ventures
identity_check: Confirmed as Courtside Ventures (courtsidevc.com), the sports, gaming and lifestyle early-stage VC firm: launched 2016 with Dan Gilbert, Bruin Sports Capital and WPP (Global Venturing); Fund III release lists The Athletic, StockX, 100 Thieves. Not Courtside Capital or other unrelated 'Courtside' entities. Firm site courtsidevc.com refused connection when fetched.

open_items: Only one round recorded, and it is from January 2017 (outside the 24-month preference). Search summaries mention Rythm Health Series A (Nov 2025) and Fanstake $6.25M seed, not fetched.

Fund I ($35M, 2016-01-13 launch) is confirmed by Global Venturing but not recorded as a fund (article dated launch, not close). A Fund IV (Sportico, Michael Jordan) appears only in search summary; Sportico fetch redirected to a paywall host; Bloomberg returned 403.

Fund III release names early Fund III investments (Hypothetic, Matchday, Mojo, Xpoint, Jackpot.com and others) but gives no round details. Detroit presence mentioned by Global Venturing, but the 2023 dateline is New York; HQ set to New York. Check size not stated.
Fund II ($60M, 2018) from search summaries not confirmed.
